name: Purple Tiger 90
author: Webdevava
description: Dark black button that reacts on hover with a smooth transition.
howItWorks: On hover, border becomes 3px solid #fff, transform becomes rotate3d(0, 1, 0.5, 360deg).
combined:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Purple Tiger 90</title>
<style>
/* Purple Tiger 90 by Webdevava — https://uiverse.io/Webdevava/purple-tiger-90 */
button {
  background: #111;
  border: none;
  padding: 10px 14px;
  border-radius: 6px;
  color: #fff;
  font-size: 30px;
}

button:hover {
  border: 3px solid #fff;
  transform: rotate3d(0, 1, 0.5, 360deg);
  transition: 1.5s;
}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<button>
  Button
</button>

</body>
</html>
